doc: What the side model (role: redraw; phase 5 of plans/261013-0718-ai-surround-live-path, T4) receives for one new drawing, for each side, and what it returns. Every candidate of phase 5's bake-off (D learned carry, B wing specialist, A streaming video model, D + zones) reads this contract and nothing else, so swapping the model touches no other role. The worker builds one record per new drawing (a frame whose drawing differs from the previous one: camera_model.CameraTracker.new_drawing); a repeated drawing gets no record and the player keeps showing the last output (no boil by construction). A change of any field's meaning, shape or units is a new schema major.

units.time: film seconds on the rebased timeline and film frame indices of the frame table (live/__init__.py: the content model's and the player's frame times, bit for bit)
units.source_px: pixels of the stored video frame, continuous: pixel u spans [u, u + 1), its centre at u + 0.5 (spikes/film-analysis/schema/common.schema.json)
units.world_px: the shot's canvas world (one per set of shots that show one place): a frame's camera map W (3x3, projective) takes its source px to world px (live/camera_model.py, VERSION in the record)
units.side_px: the side's own raster: side px (i, j) has its centre at source px (x0 + (i + 0.5) * s, y0 + (j + 0.5) * s), s = source px per side px (geometry.scale)
units.colour: RGB uint8 in the film's own encoding (the decoded frame's sRGB-like values, no display gain); the player applies the side's display gain after

geometry.doc: Per side, the region beside the picture's crop it covers, in source px. X1's geometry: a side is side_share of the picture's width wide and the crop's full height. Left: x in [crop_x0 - w, crop_x0); right: [crop_x1, crop_x1 + w); w = side_share * (crop_x1 - crop_x0); rows [crop_y0, crop_y1). Top and bottom sides follow the same rule along the other axis when the room needs them (not built).

fields.name: crop
fields.doc: the picture's crop (x0, y0, x1, y1), source px (analyse_v0)

fields.name: side_share
fields.doc: 0.5 (the product's 16:9 picture with a side half its width on each hand)

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: source px per side px: 1.0 at the film's own size (phase 3: sides at half the film's detail read as a join line, so the seam band stays at 1.0; coarser further out only where the gate's detail step passes)

fields.name: seam_band_px
fields.doc: 256: the width of the picture band and of the full-detail band of the output next to the seam

record.doc: One per new drawing; both sides in one batch.

fields.name: frame
fields.doc: film frame index of the new drawing

fields.name: shot
fields.doc: shot id (the frame table's); the model never reads across a cut

fields.name: drawing
fields.doc: index of this drawing within the shot (0 = the shot's first: no previous output)

fields.name: camera
fields.doc: W (3x3 f64, this frame's source px -> world px), W_prev (the previous drawing's), model (still | translation | homography | arbitrated | predicted), agreement (0-1: how well the map holds in the picture's outer bands), camera_version

fields.name: gain
fields.doc: the side's display gain (analyse_v0, per side) at this frame and the previous drawing's: the model outputs in film colour, the player multiplies

inputs.doc: Per side, every input in that side's raster unless said otherwise. mask: u8, 255 where the input has pixels.

fields.name: picture_band
fields.doc: the picture's own pixels next to the seam at full size (the model's anchor for detail and colour at the seam)

fields.name: picture_thumb
fields.doc: the whole picture, area-scaled: what is going on in it

fields.name: prev_side
fields.shape: H x W x 3, u8 + mask
fields.producer: the side model's own previous output, warped by structure (one projective resampling: W^-1 . W_prev)
fields.doc: the last shown side carried by the camera to this drawing; empty at drawing 0. The model starts from it (X1c: a carried side breaks within 1-3 frames on real moves and drifts worse than a frozen one, so it is a starting point, never shown raw)

fields.name: plate
fields.shape: H x W x 4, u8 (alpha = coverage)
fields.producer: painter.py (T2 plate) or mosaic_t1.py (T1 mosaic) canvas, sampled through the canvas's world mapping (texel i at world px x0 + i * scale)
fields.doc: the world's long-term memory; tier (1 or 2) and canvas generation in the record; empty when neither is ready (paint mode)

fields.name: exit_strips
fields.shape: H x W x 4, u8 (alpha = coverage)
fields.doc: the picture's last view of what left it across this side's edge, accumulated over the shot

fields.name: zones
fields.shape: H x 1, u8 + per side scalars
fields.doc: rows along the seam where the picture's change next to the seam is not explained by hold, camera slide or gain (zone), and the step's state, u_step, u_drift, u_near, gain: where invention is needed

fields.name: identity
fields.doc: crops of the characters the seam cuts, with their cluster ids: a cut-off character keeps its look (A14B and the plate invented a scarf and a ponytail)

fields.name: coming
fields.shape: N x (picture_band + W relative to this drawing), N <= 8
fields.doc: the shot's next drawings (the film is known ahead; never past the shot's end): chunk-bidirectional updates may read them

output.doc: Per side: the whole side for this drawing, shown as it is until the next drawing (the player does not warp it; the seam pull stays).

fields.name: side
fields.doc: film colour, matched to the picture at the seam; full detail in the seam_band_px next to the seam

output.judged_by: live/side_gate.py at the gate's scale (X1c's strip: the picture 960 px wide): every frame passes every bar in live/side-gate.json (seam break, drift and snap, detail, boil); with a truth on the held-out moments, without one in real use
